main_text.p: le, felle ac veneno madens. Prout itaque vinum, ex bene sanis uvibus expressum, symbolum est doctrinæ euangelicæ, cujus est sitim justitiæ satiare, atque conscientiam afflictorum omni solatio lætificare. Conf. Joel. 2 : 18. Jes. 55 : 1. Zach. 9 : 17. Ita è contra vinum hoc, cujus omnia effecta sunt contraria, ponitur ut symbolum damnosæ illius doctrinæ, quam pseudo-ecclesiæ doctores ex sinu suo effunderent. Ad veneni acumen exaggerandum confertur cum toxico animalium maximè venenatorum, quales sunt dracones & viperæ, de quibus videndus Cl. Bochartus. Scilicet horum toxica lethifera sunt, ita ut draconum subito vitam extinguat; viperinum acerrimum non sine multis doloribus homines enecare solet. Ita effecta indicantur in hominibus spiritualiter enecandis, ut aliis subitaneum infinuet stuporem; alii male curatæ conscientiæ morsus & rosiones sentiant: unde colligas eorum doctrinam nihil prodesse, nec ad vitam sanctitatis, nec ad solatium conscientiæ.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are only partly legible at this scan resolution; the two notes given are my best reading and may be incomplete. The lower part of the page shows show-through and blotting, not printed text. The printed "RE-" at the lower right is a catchword, which is why it is listed under bottom_margin. Printed text in the upper line of the first column is partly faded; "solatio" and "conscientiæ" are doubtful and not marked with [?] only because they are clear enough on the scan.
